inputs.original_text: They’re dressing up a new design mandate for guns sold in New York as a way to prevent illegal machine-gun conversions, but that safety story looks like cover for expanding control over what people can buy. The reference to criminal penalties makes it more than advice: it signals enforcement. And the message cuts off before explaining what those penalties apply to—conveniently leaving the scope of the plan in the dark.
